title: RS-485 multidrop bus
goal: A reader must be able to identify three transceiver taps on one A/B pair, end-only termination, and the single-node fail-safe bias network.

rubric.must: All three MAX3485 nodes visibly tap the same two nets labelled A and B.
Exactly two 120 Ω termination resistors bridge A to B, labelled at the left and right physical ends.
The middle transceiver node has no 120 Ω resistor drawn across its A and B connection.
A 680 Ω pull-up from VCC to A and a 680 Ω pull-down from B to common are visible at one node.
All three transceiver blocks visibly share the common return marked COM.
Each of the three transceiver blocks is labelled MAX3485 and NODE 1, 2, or 3.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. A and B run as two horizontal bus rails with all three transceivers tapping them, RT1 at the far left and RT2 at the far right, fail-safe bias at node 1 only, COM along the bottom. The 'termination at both ends' rule is expressed by placement, which is the only way a netlist can express it.
